sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु धूम्राक्षो राक्षसेन्द्रेण धीमता ।कृत्वा प्रणामं संहृष्टो निर्जगाम नृपालयात् ।। ६.५१.२० ।।।।
transliteration: evamuktastu dhūmrākṣo rākṣasendreṇa dhīmatā ।kṛtvā praṇāmaṁ saṁhṛṣṭo nirjagāma nṛpālayāt ।। 6.51.20 ।।।।

translations.english: "Dhumraksha of fierce prowess, you along with a huge Rakshasa army go just now to destroy Rama along with able Vanaras."
